assertionResults.title: Three-segment control
assertionResults.reason: The workers tab selector now matches the contract: the shell is a mist-2 pill with 3px padding, the active segment uses a white fill, and selected labels use semibold (600) on Android and iOS.

references.details: Workers screen wraps the selector in a pill shell with colors.surface[200], borderRadius.full, and padding: 3 before rendering the three Workers/Attendance/Analytics segments.
SegmentedControl renders the selected segment with backgroundColor: '#FFFFFF' and applies fontWeight.semibold to selected labels on both Android and iOS.
Theme maps surface[200] to mist-2 (#EEE7DD) and semibold to 600, matching the contract language.

assertionResults.title: Full/Half/Absent toggle buttons
assertionResults.reason: Each attendance row now uses pill-shaped Full/Half/Absent toggles with the required green/amber/red state colors and matching dot indicators inside each toggle.

references.details: Worker attendance rows render Full, Half, and Absent controls as pill-shaped Pressables with explicit state colors #4F7A5A, #C58A2B, and #B84C3A.
Each toggle now includes a 6x6 circular dot whose color tracks the corresponding attendance state.
Theme defines borderRadius.pill for the pill treatment used by the state controls.

assertionResults.title: Mark All Present button
assertionResults.reason: The bottom sticky CTA remains full width with primary background and white text, and it now uses borderRadius.sm, which resolves to the required 12px radius.

references.details: The sticky bottom action renders the Mark All Present label in a full-width primary button with white text.
CTA styling now uses borderRadius.sm instead of borderRadius.md.
Theme defines borderRadius.sm as 12, satisfying the contract requirement for the CTA corner radius.
